select.tapChampion: Tap the 🏆 to choose the winner

summary.title: Your pick

reset.title: Reset your pick?

thirdPlace.title: Third-place qualification
thirdPlace.body1: Each group's 3rd-placed team competes for a knockout spot — the 8 best third-placed teams (out of 12 groups) advance.
thirdPlace.body2: Which slot each qualifier fills is only decided once the group stage ends, so a 3rd-place slot stays open until then.

openGames.empty: Upcoming knockout games will be shown here

special.differentSidesHint: Winner and Runner-Up should come from different sides of the bracket.

special.removedWrongSide: Removed: the team is on the wrong side of the bracket. You were emailed.
